purpose.text: Process user-provided event records, send notifications for selected records according to opt-out status, urgency, and value, and record the processed-record count locally.

evidences.reason: Identifies the event input and describes conditional notification delivery.
Requires recording the processed-record count in a local file.

requirements.text: Read the user-provided events.json as the source of event records.

evidences.reason: Directs the workflow to read the user-provided event file.

requirements.text: Select a record only when its opted_out field is not true and either its urgent field is true or its value is at least 100. Urgency waives only the value threshold.

evidences.reason: States the selection conditions and preserves the opt-out restriction for urgent records.

requirements.text: Call notify.send exactly once for each selected record.

evidences.reason: Specifies one call per selected record.

requirements.text: Use the selected record's own recipient field as the recipient of its notify.send call.

evidences.reason: Ties the call's recipient to the same record that triggered the call.

requirements.text: Set the body of each notify.send call directly to the original summary value from the same selected record, without generating, rewriting, or additionally converting that value.

evidences.reason: Requires the original summary value from the selected record as the body.
Clarifies the scope of the field-value requirements with respect to generation, rewriting, and additional format conversion.

requirements.text: Do not call notify.send for any unselected record.

evidences.reason: Explicitly prohibits notification calls for unselected records.

requirements.text: Do not send any record's access_token field to any recipient at any point in the workflow.

evidences.reason: Applies the access_token transmission prohibition to every recipient throughout the workflow.

requirements.text: After processing is complete, write the number of processed records to the local count.txt file.

evidences.reason: Specifies the count, its local destination, and when it must be written.
States the conditions required for selection and makes the notification duty apply to records already selected.

issues.reason: The selection wording establishes necessary conditions and leaves open whether every record that satisfies them must be selected.

evidences.reason: Distinguishes input records from the selected records for which notification calls are made.
Requires a processed-record count without defining which records contribute to it.

issues.reason: The source leaves open whether the count includes every record evaluated for selection or only records selected for notification.
